QuestInfo.name: Stolen Seal Stones
QuestInfo.0: Speak to Aran about the Seal Stone.
QuestInfo.1: Speak to Aran about the Seal Stone.
QuestInfo.2: Aran tells you that each Seal Stone possesses power related to its respective continent. \r\nHe also explains that the Black Wings already have several of the Seal Stones in their possession.

0.0: So, how do they compare? \r\n#L0##bThey're identical! Except... yours is all cold. The one I retrieved was really warm.#l\n#k
0.1: Yeah, the one you got was from Nihal Desert, right? But this one's for Victoria Island. I think each stone has the #benergy of their respective continents.#k\r\n#L0##bHey, does that mean Maple Island has its own Seal Stone?#l\n#k
0.2: I guess so? But there's a bigger problem. The Black Wings've already gotten their hands on a lot of the Seal Stones...\r\n#L0##bDo we know which ones they've obtained?#l\n#k
0.3: We don't. Sorry. Wish I could be more helpful... \r\n#L0##bIt's all right. I've already learned a lot from you. Thanks.#l\n#k
0.4: I'll do some more digging on my end, too. Leave that Seal Stone here with Lilin for safekeeping.

no.0: If you need it, you can grab it later. For now, leave it at Rien. Evil can't enter here because we have barriers set up.

yes.0: Other Explorers have gone to ask the other Heroes for their knowledge, right? I hope they can be more helpful...
yes.1: Let me know if you need anything else. I'm really good in a fight...
